laws.rule: Each fire season the Muğla governor issues a General Order (Genel Emir) closing named forest areas. The 2026 order (2026/1) bans entry to the listed forests without permission from 1 June to 31 October 2026. Stopping for a break or picnic beside those forests and on roads through them is banned. Picnics are allowed only in registered picnic areas and without fire. Burning of crop and garden residue is also banned in rural areas. The areas and dates are reissued each year, so the current order needs checking.
laws.penalty_signal: not stated in the order; it relies on the Forest Law (6831, art. 74) and Provincial Administration Law (5442)
